shared_qualifications: C1: V(SCE)×1000=mV(SCE), with no electrode offset. PDF p.6: pure aluminium foil, 24 h immersion in deaerated solutions, potentiostatic determination. The concentration series does not supply a numerical pH, so CRA pH 7 is not treated as measured paper context.

Figure 1 and Table 1 repeat four numerical results; additional Figure 1 markers remain distinct. Figure 3 is a buffer-pH series (p.9); equal potentials across series do not establish the same experiment. Experimental temperature 25°C is not independently stated in the inspected contextual passages.
Figure 3 pH readings 8.15/9.45 are graphical coordinates, compatible with CRA 8.1/9.4. Obs_016 retains graphical pH≈10.2 despite text saying no pitting-potential measurements above pH 10.
